description: This file defines the implementation of the MediaKeySessionTestBase class, which provides mock-based setup, teardown, and utility functions for testing MediaKeySession behavior in a media DRM context. It includes methods for creating and destroying key sessions, generating requests, and setting expectations for session closure, primarily used in unit tests.

classes.name: MediaKeySessionTestBase
classes.description: A base class providing mock setup and utility functions for testing MediaKeySession in a media DRM context.

methods.name: MediaKeySessionTestBase
methods.description: Constructor initializing mock objects for testing.

methods.name: createKeySession
methods.description: Sets up expectations and creates a MediaKeySession instance with a specified key system.

methods.name: destroyKeySession
methods.description: Sets expectation for unregistering the client.

methods.name: expectCloseKeySession
methods.description: Sets expectations for closing a session based on the key system.

methods.name: generateRequest
methods.description: Mocks the construction of a session and verifies generateRequest behavior.

methods.name: mainThreadWillEnqueueTask
methods.description: Sets expectation for enqueuing a task on the main thread.
